operators.name: reduce_max
semantics: Computes maximum over all elements of input x, equivalent to torch.max(x).
Returns a 0-dim CUDA float32 tensor containing the maximum value.
For empty tensors, unspecified (not exercised by task).

operators.name: reduce_std
semantics: Computes unbiased standard deviation over all elements of input x, equivalent to torch.std(x) (correction=1, mean over all elements).
Returns a 0-dim CUDA float32 tensor containing the standard deviation value.
Input must have at least 2 elements (not exercised).
Output is a scalar CUDA float32 tensor.
Global standard deviation with default unbiased estimator (correction=1).
Output is a scalar CUDA float32 tensor.
Return tuple containing max tensor then std tensor.
